userStories.title: Initialize repository workspace git config and project root files

acceptanceCriteria: Repository root contains initialized `.git` directory and clean working tree.
`.gitignore` exists covering `node_modules`, `.next`, `.env`, and build artifacts.
`.editorconfig` specifies 2-space indentation, UTF-8 encoding, and LF line endings.
`README.md` documents repository layout, setup prerequisites, and development scripts.
Root `package.json` initializes project name as `spotify` with private package status.

userStories.title: Scaffold Next.js 14 fullstack monolith project baseline

acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 14 App Router project initialized with TypeScript 5.x configuration in root directory.
`tsconfig.json` enforces `strict: true`, `target: ES2022`, and path aliases `@/*` pointing to `./src/*`.
`app/layout.tsx` and `app/page.tsx` exist as minimal functional React Server Components.
Running `npm run build` completes with exit code 0 and produces optimized standalone build output.
Running `npm run dev` boots Next.js development server on `http://localhost:3000` without runtime errors.

userStories.title: Install core dependencies and configure Tailwind CSS with shadcn UI
userStories.description: Install Tailwind CSS 3.4+, Radix UI primitives, shadcn/ui integration, lucide-react icons, and music-metadata. Sets up dark-mode first HSL design tokens, responsive grid defaults down to 375px viewports, and utility styling classes.
acceptanceCriteria: Dependencies `@radix-ui/react-slot`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `lucide-react`, `music-metadata` installed in `package.json`.
`tailwind.config.js` configures dark mode, HSL color tokens, typography scales, and content paths for `/src`.
`src/app/globals.css` defines CSS custom properties for dark-first HSL palette and WCAG AA contrast levels.
`components.json` configured for shadcn/ui primitive component auto-generation.
Unit test verifies helper utility `cn()` correctly merges Tailwind CSS classes.

userStories.title: Implement MongoDB database schema and Prisma ORM models
userStories.description: Configure Prisma ORM v5.x with MongoDB provider. Implement all 8 core canonical models (User, ArtistProfile, Track, Playlist, PlaylistTrack, Like, Follow, Report, AuditLog) and required enums, compound unique indexes, and relational attributes.
acceptanceCriteria: `prisma/schema.prisma` created with MongoDB provider and 8 canonical models matching exact field specifications.
Enums `UserRole`, `AccountStatus`, `TrackStatus`, `Genre`, `ReportReason`, `ReportStatus`, and `AuditAction` defined.
Compound unique indexes `@unique([playlistId, position])`, `@unique([playlistId, trackId])`, `@unique([userId, trackId])`, `@unique([followerId, artistProfileId])` configured.
`npx prisma validate` succeeds and `npx prisma generate` outputs type-safe PrismaClient SDK.
Unit test instantiates PrismaClient and validates all model typings compile without TypeScript errors.

userStories.title: Implement StorageService interface abstraction for S3 signed URLs
userStories.description: Implement the vendor-agnostic `StorageService` interface wrapping `@aws-sdk/client-s3`. Provides methods for file upload, object deletion, and generating 60-minute presigned PUT upload URLs and 15-minute presigned GET stream delivery URLs.
acceptanceCriteria: `StorageService` interface implemented in `src/lib/storage/storage.service.ts` with `uploadObject`, `deleteObject`, `generateSignedUrl`.
`S3StorageService` implementation handles AWS S3 / Cloudflare R2 compatible endpoint configurations.
`generateSignedUrl` enforces 3600-second TTL cap for `getObject` streaming requests.
Unit tests mock S3 client and verify correct presigned URL generation and parameter passing for `putObject` and `getObject`.
Integration test validates audio upload size constraint validation helper caps files at 50MB.

userStories.title: Implement standardized REST API response wrappers and validation middleware
userStories.description: Implement standard API JSON success and error outer envelopes, request ID tracing, UTC ISO-8601 timestamping, and a Zod schema validation middleware returning 422 Unprocessable Entity details arrays.
acceptanceCriteria: Success helper `apiSuccessResponse(data, meta)` constructs payload with `success: true`, `data`, UTC timestamp, and `requestId`.
Error helper `apiErrorResponse(code, message, details)` constructs payload with `success: false`, `error` code, and optional `details` array.
Validation middleware `validateBody(schema)` validates Zod schema and returns HTTP 422 with `ValidationErrorDetail` format on failure.
Passwords and sensitive credentials are sanitized and excluded from error payload outputs and log traces.
Integration tests cover `apiSuccessResponse`, `apiErrorResponse`, and Zod validation failure scenarios for HTTP status codes 400, 422, and 500.

userStories.title: Implement JWT authentication middleware and admin RBAC route guards
userStories.description: Build server-side authentication middleware handling 7-day HTTP-only cookies containing JWT session tokens. Implement bcrypt cost-12 password hashing helpers and strict server-side RBAC middleware for `/api/v1/admin/*` and `/admin/*` routes.
acceptanceCriteria: `hashPassword` and `comparePassword` utilities wrap `bcryptjs` using cost factor 12.
`generateToken` and `verifyToken` helpers handle 7-day JWT stateless session payloads.
Next.js `middleware.ts` intercepts `/admin/*` and `/api/v1/admin/*` routes, enforcing `ADMIN` user role server-side.
Unauthenticated requests to protected paths return HTTP 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`, non-admin requests return HTTP 403 `FORBIDDEN_INSUFFICIENT_ROLE`.
Integration tests verify JWT session extraction from HTTP-only cookies and RBAC route protection for Listener vs Admin roles.

userStories.title: Implement limit-offset pagination contracts and response helpers
userStories.description: Create standard pagination parser and formatter utilities for REST collection endpoints. Enforces 1-indexed page numbers, default 20-item limits, 100-item maximum caps, and paginated API response JSON structures.
acceptanceCriteria: `parsePaginationParams(url)` parses `page` (default 1) and `limit` (default 20, max 100).
`apiPaginatedResponse(data, total, page, limit)` returns JSON envelope containing `data[]`, `pagination` object (`total`, `page`, `limit`, `totalPages`, `hasNextPage`, `hasPreviousPage`), and `meta`.
`limit` values exceeding 100 are automatically clamped to 100.
Unit tests in `src/lib/api/pagination.test.ts` test default fallback, maximum clamping, and total page calculation math.
Integration test verifies query parameter parsing against a dummy collection route.

userStories.title: Configure Vitest unit integration test runner and Playwright E2E setup
userStories.description: Configure Vitest for server/service unit testing and Playwright for frontend E2E browser testing. Includes test scripts in `package.json`, environment setup, and baseline passing test suites.
acceptanceCriteria: Vitest configured with `@testing-library/react` and Node.js environment in `vitest.config.ts`.
Playwright configured in `playwright.config.ts` targeting standard web viewports (desktop and 375px mobile).
`npm run test` executes Vitest unit/integration tests with exit code 0.
`npm run test:e2e` executes Playwright specs against running dev server with exit code 0.
Sample unit test `src/lib/sample.test.ts` and sample E2E spec `e2e/home.spec.ts` pass cleanly.

userStories.title: Configure environment variable schema template and GitHub Actions CI workflow
userStories.description: Create `.env.example` defining all required runtime secrets and setup a GitHub Actions CI pipeline running linting, TypeScript compilation, Prisma schema validation, Vitest unit tests, and Playwright E2E suites.
acceptanceCriteria: `.env.example` created listing `DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_SECRET`, `AWS_REGION`, `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `S3_BUCKET_NAME`, `S3_ENDPOINT`.
`src/lib/env.ts` implements Zod parsing for process.env at server startup.
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` created with steps: checkout, node setup, install dependencies, lint, typecheck, prisma validate, vitest run, playwright test.
Build fails in CI if TypeScript compilation contains errors or test coverage target is breached.
Manual execution of CI workflow steps locally succeeds cleanly.

userStories.title: Implement Bcrypt Password Hashing and Payload Sanitization Utility
userStories.description: Create a backend security service using bcrypt with cost factor 12 and 16-byte random salt to hash user passwords prior to storage in MongoDB. Include automatic sanitization functions to strip passwordHash from Prisma database queries and API response payloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Hashing passwords using bcrypt generates a valid salt and hash using cost factor 12.
Verifying a raw password against the stored hash returns true for correct input and false for invalid input.
Sanitization helper function strips passwordHash from User model objects before JSON serialization.
Prisma query select wrappers omit passwordHash from returned fields unless explicitly selected.
Password hashes are never written to standard log streams or error stack trace outputs per sec-024 sensitive data security rules.
Unit tests in tests/unit/security/password.test.ts verify hashing, cost factor 12 execution time (~250ms), verification logic, and payload sanitization.

userStories.title: Implement Session JWT Token Service and Secure Cookie Serialization
userStories.description: Develop a stateless JWT session token management service that signs and verifies claims including userId, role, and optional artistProfileId using HMAC-SHA256. Configure HTTP-only, SameSite=Strict, Secure cookie serialization with a 7-day expiration under __Host-indie_session.
acceptanceCriteria: JWT token generation includes userId, role ('LISTENER'|'ARTIST'|'ADMIN'), optional artistProfileId, iat, and exp claims signed with JWT_SECRET.
Session cookie serialization sets __Host-indie_session with HttpOnly: true, Secure: true, SameSite: Strict, Path: /, and Max-Age: 604800 (7 days).
Expired or tampered JWT signatures fail verification and throw a structured session invalidation error.
All timestamp claims (iat, exp) adhere to UTC ISO-8601 / Unix epoch standards in UTC per constraint 0.
Unit tests in tests/unit/security/session.test.ts cover token creation, claim validation, signature tampering, expiration checks, and cookie header formatting.

userStories.title: Implement Next.js Edge Middleware for Server-Side Route Guarding
userStories.description: Build Next.js Edge Middleware in middleware.ts to intercept protected routes /admin/*, /api/v1/admin/*, /api/v1/artist/*, /api/v1/playlists/*, and /api/v1/reports/*. Verify session cookies, validate role hierarchy, and inject decoded identity claims into request headers.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated requests targeting protected routes return HTTP status 401 Unauthorized.
Authenticated requests lacking required roles (e.g. Listener accessing /admin/*) return HTTP status 403 Forbidden per constraint 3.
Valid requests propagate decoded session claims in custom request headers x-user-id, x-user-role, and x-artist-profile-id to downstream handlers.
Public routes (such as guest search and track streaming) bypass middleware role checks per DEC-005.
Unit tests cover middleware claim parsing and route matcher logic.
Integration tests verify HTTP 401, 403, and header injection behavior for protected API routes.

userStories.title: Implement Resource Ownership Verification Helpers and IDOR Protection
userStories.description: Implement reusable backend resource authorization functions to enforce Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) protection in REST API route handlers. Ensure users can only modify or delete their own Track and Playlist records unless they hold the Admin role.
acceptanceCriteria: Track ownership check confirms Track.artistProfileId equals caller's artistProfileId or caller holds ADMIN role.
Playlist ownership check confirms Playlist.userId equals caller's userId or caller holds ADMIN role.
Failed ownership checks abort execution and return HTTP 403 Forbidden with code ERR_RESOURCE_OWNERSHIP_DENIED and detailed resource info.
Admin role overrides ownership restrictions across all Track and Playlist update and delete handlers.
Integration tests assert HTTP 403 response structure when an unauthorized user attempts to edit another user's playlist or track.

userStories.title: Implement Higher-Order withAuth and withRole API Handler Wrappers
userStories.description: Create higher-order functions withAuth and withRole to wrap Next.js API handlers, extract session claims, build an immutable AuthContext, and handle authentication error responses uniformly.
acceptanceCriteria: withAuth extracts claims from request headers injected by middleware or direct cookie verification and constructs immutable AuthContext.
withRole verifies that AuthContext.user.role matches one of the specified allowed roles for the route.
Token invalidation or expiry caught inside the wrapper returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized with standardized envelope error code ERR_UNAUTHORIZED.
Unit tests in tests/unit/security/wrappers.test.ts verify AuthContext injection and role boundary validation.
Integration tests confirm 401 error envelope format when calling wrapped endpoints without valid session headers.

userStories.title: Implement Unified StorageProvider Interface for S3 and Cloudflare R2
userStories.description: Build the StorageProvider abstraction layer utilizing AWS SDK v3 to support Amazon S3 and Cloudflare R2 object storage backends. Dynamically select provider implementation based on the STORAGE_PROVIDER environment variable.
acceptanceCriteria: StorageProvider interface exposes generatePresignedUploadUrl, generatePresignedDownloadUrl, deleteObject, and getObjectMetadata.
System initializes AWS S3 or Cloudflare R2 client according to STORAGE_PROVIDER ('s3' or 'r2') environment configuration per DEC-008.
Presigned upload URLs generate valid S3/R2 PUT targets with specified TTL.
Presigned download URLs generate access-controlled GET targets with specified TTL.
Unit tests mock AWS SDK calls to test presigned URL creation, metadata reading, and object deletion.
Integration tests against mock S3 storage verify presigned upload token generation and metadata retrieval.

userStories.title: Implement Upload Intent API Endpoint with Media Validation
userStories.description: Create backend endpoint POST /api/v1/storage/upload-intent to validate file metadata against audio and image size/MIME rules before returning direct-to-storage presigned upload URLs.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint accepts fileType ('audio'|'image'), fileName, fileSizeBytes, and mimeType.
Audio uploads are restricted to MP3 (audio/mpeg) and WAV (audio/wav) up to 50MB (52,428,800 bytes) per constraint 1.
Cover image uploads are restricted to JPEG, PNG, and WebP up to 10MB (10,485,760 bytes).
Invalid file formats or sizes exceeding limits return HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity with details before presigning.
Valid requests return HTTP 200 OK with a 60-minute presigned PUT URL and deterministic object key (audio/{artistId}/{trackId}_{uuid}.{ext} or images/{artistId}/{imageId}_{uuid}.webp).
Integration test verifies POST /api/v1/storage/upload-intent with valid and invalid audio payloads.

userStories.title: Implement Presigned Playback Stream URL Endpoint and Byte Range Headers
userStories.description: Create backend endpoint GET /api/v1/tracks/:id/stream to issue short-lived GET presigned playback URLs (15-minute TTL) with HTTP byte-range request header support for low-latency streaming.
acceptanceCriteria: Request generates a presigned GET URL with a 900-second (15-minute) expiration for track playback per DEC-008.
Allows unauthenticated guest access for public track streaming per DEC-005.
Emits HTTP response headers Accept-Ranges: bytes and Cache-Control: private, max-age=900.
Supports HTTP 206 Partial Content range responses with Content-Range: bytes <start>-<end>/<total> to meet SLA of under 2 seconds audio playback start per sec-024.
Unit tests verify stream URL generation and expiry configuration.
Integration test calls GET /api/v1/tracks/:id/stream and verifies response headers and presigned stream URL payload.

userStories.title: Implement Frontend Direct-to-Storage Upload Hook and Upload Component
userStories.description: Build React hook useDirectUpload and UI component FileUploadProgress to request presigned upload URLs from the storage API and execute client-side direct binary uploads to S3/R2 with progress indicators.
acceptanceCriteria: useDirectUpload hook manages request flow: POST /upload-intent, direct S3/R2 PUT binary transfer, progress state, and completion.
UI displays real-time progress bar, transfer percentage, and error notifications adhering to design tokens.
Pre-upload client validation checks file size (max 50MB audio) and MIME format before network requests.
Upload controls and progress indicators satisfy WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility keyboard and screen reader standards per constraint 5.
Responsive layout scales down gracefully to 375px mobile viewports per sec-026.
Unit tests in tests/unit/components/upload.test.tsx test hook states and upload validation.
Playwright E2E spec in e2e/tests/upload-flow.spec.ts verifies selecting an audio file, observing progress, and completing direct upload.

userStories.title: Implement User Registration API Endpoint and Payload Validation
userStories.description: Build POST /api/v1/auth/register API endpoint to validate registration payloads, enforce email normalization and uniqueness, create User records with bcrypt password hashes, and return a 7-day session cookie.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts { email, password, displayName }, normalizes email to lowercase, and validates password strength (min 8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 digit).
Returns HTTP 409 Conflict with code AUTH_EMAIL_EXISTS if email is already registered.
Hashes password using bcrypt cost 12 and creates User record with role LISTENER per DEC-004.
Sets __Host-indie_session HTTP-only, SameSite=Strict cookie with 7-day TTL and returns HTTP 201 Created with sanitized user object.
Timestamps (createdAt) are stored and returned in UTC ISO-8601 format per constraint 0.
Passwords are sanitized out of response payloads and never logged per constraint 4 and sec-024 rules.
Integration test asserts POST /api/v1/auth/register creates user, sets session cookie, and returns sanitized envelope.

userStories.title: Implement User Login API Endpoint with Rate Limiting
userStories.description: Build POST /api/v1/auth/login endpoint to authenticate registered users via email and password, issue session cookies, and enforce a 5-attempt per 15-minute rate limit policy per IP address.
acceptanceCriteria: Validates email and password, returning HTTP 200 OK and setting the 7-day __Host-indie_session cookie upon successful match.
Returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized with code INVALID_CREDENTIALS for non-existent emails or incorrect passwords.
Enforces rate limiting: exceeding 5 failed login attempts in 15 minutes per IP triggers HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with code RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED per sec-025.
Password inputs and failure attempts do not output plaintext credentials to application loggers per constraint 4.
Integration test verifies successful login cookie issuance, 401 error envelope on invalid credentials, and 429 rate limit triggering after 5 failed attempts.

userStories.title: Implement Password Reset and Credential Management APIs
userStories.description: Implement backend endpoints POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password, POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password, and PATCH /api/v1/auth/password for self-service password recovery and authenticated credential updates.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password generates a 60-minute reset token stored as a hash in DB and returns a uniform HTTP 200 OK response to prevent email enumeration.
POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password validates reset token, updates bcrypt password hash, invalidates used token, and revokes active session cookies.
PATCH /api/v1/auth/password verifies caller's currentPassword, updates to newPassword, and regenerates the session token.
Password reset tokens and updated hashes use UTC ISO-8601 expiration timestamps per constraint 0.
Integration tests cover forgot password uniform response, reset password execution, token expiry rejection, and credential update logic.

userStories.title: Implement Log Sanitization and Password Field Protection Middleware
userStories.description: Build global logging middleware to intercept incoming request bodies on auth routes and sanitize sensitive credential fields (password, oldPassword, newPassword) before passing logs to central monitoring.
acceptanceCriteria: Middleware inspects incoming payload bodies on /api/v1/auth/* routes and replaces sensitive keys with [REDACTED].
Structured application error logs strip password fields from stack traces and error details.
Data in transit is enforced over TLS 1.3 encrypted connections per sec-025.
Unit tests in tests/unit/middleware/sanitizer.test.ts verify payload redaction across various nested JSON structures.

userStories.title: Implement Guest Session Migration Service
userStories.description: Create client and backend helper functions to migrate temporary in-memory/localStorage guest playlist drafts and queue state into permanent Playlist records upon user registration or sign-in.
acceptanceCriteria: Guest session state reader extracts local draft playlist tracks from client storage post-registration.
Client issues POST /api/v1/playlists with guest playlist data to create permanent database records linked to the new User.id.
Active audio streaming player state is preserved continuously across registration without resetting playback per DEC-005.
Unit tests verify guest state extraction and payload formatting.
Integration test validates converting a guest playlist payload into a persisted Playlist entity.

userStories.title: Implement Frontend Account Registration Page and Interactive Form
userStories.description: Build Next.js user registration page /register featuring Zod schema client-side validation, password strength meter, show/hide password toggle, accessible loading states, and responsive shadcn layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders /register page using dark-mode design system tokens, responsive grid layouts down to 375px mobile viewports per sec-026.
Input fields for email, password, and displayName validate on blur and submit using Zod schema rules.
Password input features an interactive visibility toggle button (masked vs unmasked) and real-time password strength meter.
API submission displays active loading spinner on submit button, disables re-clicks with aria-disabled="true".
Server errors (such as AUTH_EMAIL_EXISTS) render in an accessible alert banner at the top of the form with focus moved to the first invalid field per WCAG 2.1 AA (constraint 5).
Unit tests verify form validation rules and component state transitions.
Playwright E2E spec e2e/tests/register.spec.ts covers successful registration, duplicate email handling, and validation error display.

userStories.title: Implement Frontend Login Page and Form Component
userStories.description: Build Next.js user login page /login with Zod validation, error callout banners, password visibility toggle, guest session migration trigger, and seamless redirect after authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders /login page using design tokens and responsive layout down to 375px mobile viewport per sec-026.
Form validates email and password inputs, displaying inline feedback on invalid submission.
Successful login triggers guest session state migration if guest playlist items exist in local storage per DEC-005.
Password field includes show/hide visibility toggle and accessible label associations complying with WCAG 2.1 AA per constraint 5.
Server authentication errors (such as INVALID_CREDENTIALS or RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED) display in an accessible alert callout banner.
Unit tests verify login form states and submit event handling.
Playwright E2E spec e2e/tests/login.spec.ts tests valid login flow, invalid credentials error, and guest migration trigger.

userStories.title: Implement Frontend Password Recovery Pages
userStories.description: Build Next.js UI pages /forgot-password and /reset-password allowing users to request password reset links and submit new credentials with real-time feedback and accessibility.
acceptanceCriteria: /forgot-password page accepts email and presents a confirmation message regardless of email existence to prevent account enumeration.
/reset-password page extracts reset token from URL query params and validates new password against strength rules before submitting.
Visual feedback banners notify user of successful password reset and provide a link to sign in.
Form controls adhere to WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard navigation and screen reader standards per constraint 5.
Unit tests verify form schema validation and token state handling.
Playwright E2E spec e2e/tests/password-reset.spec.ts verifies full password recovery user flow from forgot-password submission to reset-password update.

userStories.title: Implement Listener to Artist Role Upgrade API Endpoint
userStories.description: Create the POST /api/v1/users/me/upgrade-to-artist API endpoint allowing registered Listener users to upgrade to an Artist role. Executes an atomic transaction to append the ARTIST role flag to User.roles, provision a linked ArtistProfile model, and return an updated JWT session payload. Preserves existing user favorites, playlists, and follow relationships without requiring re-registration.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/users/me/upgrade-to-artist appends 'ARTIST' to User.roles while preserving 'LISTENER' privileges.
Provisions an ArtistProfile record with userId, stageName (defaulting to User.name if omitted), bio, genreTags, and initial followerCount=0, trackCount=0.
Returns HTTP 200 OK with the updated User object, new ArtistProfile, and a fresh JWT containing revised role claims.
Timestamps in the response payload are formatted in UTC ISO-8601 per constraint [0].
Unit tests in src/services/role.test.ts verify atomic role update and default stageName fallback logic.
Integration test calls POST /api/v1/users/me/upgrade-to-artist with valid payload and asserts HTTP 200 plus correct database state.

userStories.title: Implement Verification Email Generation and Dispatch Service
userStories.description: Build the backend service and API endpoint POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email/request to generate cryptographically secure email verification tokens. Generates a 64-character hex token via crypto.randomBytes(32), stores a SHA-256 digest in the database with a 24-hour expiration window, invalidates previous active tokens, and dispatches a single-use verification link via email.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email/request generates a 64-character random token and persists its SHA-256 digest with expiresAt set 24 hours in the future.
Invalidates any existing active verification token records for the requesting user prior to creating a new token.
Returns HTTP 202 Accepted with a confirmation message and expiresInSeconds=86400.
Applies rate limiting on POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email/request per cross-cutting security policy sec-025.
Unit tests in src/services/emailVerification.test.ts cover token generation, SHA-256 hashing, and prior token invalidation.
Integration test calls POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email/request for an authenticated user and asserts HTTP 202 status and DB record.

userStories.title: Implement Email Verification Token Confirmation and Status APIs
userStories.description: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email/confirm to validate incoming raw tokens against SHA-256 database digests and GET /api/v1/users/me/verification-status to retrieve email verification status. Validates token freshness (expiresAt > current_time), sets User.emailVerified to true with a UTC ISO-8601 timestamp, deletes used token records, and returns explicit status data.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email/confirm hashes incoming raw token with SHA-256 and matches against active database records.
If token is valid and unexpired, updates User.emailVerified to true, sets emailVerifiedAt to UTC ISO-8601 timestamp, and deletes the token record.
If token is invalid or expired, returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with error code INVALID_VERIFICATION_TOKEN.
GET /api/v1/users/me/verification-status returns HTTP 200 OK with emailVerified, canUpload boolean, and roles array.
Unit tests in src/services/emailVerificationConfirm.test.ts cover valid token processing, expired token rejection, and invalid digest matching.
Integration test calls POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email/confirm with valid and invalid tokens and verifies exact HTTP responses.

userStories.title: Implement Email Verification Gating Middleware for Track Uploads
userStories.description: Implement the requireVerifiedEmail middleware enforcing DEC-004, which restricts track upload execution exclusively to users with verified email addresses. Intercepts request flows targeting POST /api/v1/tracks and POST /api/v1/tracks/upload-intent, rejecting unverified users with HTTP 403 Forbidden without affecting streaming, search, or playlist actions.
acceptanceCriteria: requireVerifiedEmail middleware checks User.emailVerified property on authenticated request contexts.
If User.emailVerified is false, rejects request immediately with HTTP 403 Forbidden and code EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED containing resendUrl.
Allows verified users with ARTIST role to proceed through upload execution handlers.
Explicitly leaves streaming, playback, search, following, and playlist endpoints ungated per DEC-004 and DEC-005.
Unit tests in src/middleware/requireVerifiedEmail.test.ts verify passthrough for verified users and rejection for unverified accounts.
Integration test verifies that POST /api/v1/tracks returns 403 when invoked by an unverified account.

userStories.title: Implement Frontend Artist Upgrade Form and Settings Section
userStories.description: Build the frontend artist role upgrade modal and account settings form component allowing Listeners to transition into Artists. Collects stageName, bio, and genreTags with client-side validation, submits data to POST /api/v1/users/me/upgrade-to-artist, updates global authentication state, and displays creator onboarding guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders form fields for stageName (1-50 chars), bio (max 500 chars), and genreTags (1-5 tags select) within account settings.
Complies with WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard accessibility standards and visible focus highlights per constraint [5].
On successful submission, updates session context with ARTIST role and redirects or shows artist dashboard link without requiring re-login.
Displays error alert banner if validation or API failure occurs.
Unit tests in src/components/ArtistUpgradeForm.test.tsx verify field validation, submission handling, and accessibility attributes.
Playwright spec in e2e/tests/artist-upgrade.spec.ts covers filling out the upgrade form, submitting, and verifying updated role state.

userStories.title: Implement Frontend Email Verification Confirmation Page and Notification Banner
userStories.description: Construct the email verification landing page (/verify-email) and sticky notification banner for unverified creator accounts. Reads the token query parameter on mount, invokes POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email/confirm, renders success or error confirmation states, and provides a one-click resend button triggering POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email/request.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page at /verify-email extracts token parameter and automatically triggers confirmation API request on load.
Renders success message with button to return to artist dashboard upon HTTP 200 OK response.
Renders error alert with explicit message and 'Resend Verification Email' action button when token is invalid or expired.
Displays a persistent banner in creator views when User.emailVerified is false, explaining upload gating per DEC-004.
Unit tests in src/pages/VerifyEmail.test.tsx verify token extraction, API invocation states, and error handling UI.
Playwright spec in e2e/tests/email-verification.spec.ts tests visiting /verify-email with valid and expired tokens.

userStories.title: Implement Get Public Artist Profile API with Aggregated Metrics
userStories.description: Develop the GET /api/v1/artists/:artistId endpoint to fetch public artist profiles, live tracks, and real-time aggregated metrics. Aggregates total plays across live tracks, total likes count, and followers count, and includes top 5 popular tracks ordered descending by play count.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/artists/:artistId returns public profile details (displayName, bio, avatarUrl, headerImageUrl, socialLinks, isVerified).
Calculates and returns aggregated stats: totalPlays (sum of live track playCounts), totalLikes (count of likes across tracks), and followerCount.
Returns top 5 tracks owned by artist with status 'LIVE' ordered descending by playCount.
Accessible to unauthenticated guest users per DEC-005, returning isFollowing boolean if authenticated request context exists.

userStories.description: Create the backend REST endpoint POST /api/v1/tracks/:trackId/reports to allow authenticated users and guest visitors to flag policy-violating tracks. The handler enforces sliding-window rate limits (5 per hour for registered users, 3 per hour per IP for guests), rejects duplicate reports within 24 hours with an HTTP 409 Conflict, and records reporter details or guest IP before creating a Report record.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/tracks/:trackId/reports accepts valid payloads with enumerated reasons (COPYRIGHT_VIOLATION, INAPPROPRIATE_CONTENT, SPAM_OR_MISLEADING, OTHER) and optional details capped at 500 characters, returning HTTP 201 Created with the persisted Report object.
Returns HTTP 404 Not Found if the specified trackId does not exist or is not active.
For authenticated requests, reporterId is populated from the JWT user session; for guest submissions, reporterId is set to null and client IP is logged.
Enforces sliding-window rate limits returning 429 Too Many Requests: 5 submissions/hour for authenticated users and 3 submissions/hour per IP for unauthenticated guests as specified in sec-025.
Rejects duplicate report submissions for the same track from the same User ID or IP address within a 24-hour window with HTTP 409 Conflict.
Timestamps in the created Report entity are stored in UTC ISO-8601 format per constraint 0.
Integration test in tests/api/reports.test.ts verifies successful creation, 404 missing track, 409 duplicate submission, and 429 rate limit enforcement.

userStories.title: Implement Frontend Track Report Modal and Feedback Component

The modal presents a mandatory reason dropdown, optional details text area with character counter, Submit/Cancel controls, inline error alerts, and a confirmation screen that auto-dismisses after 3 seconds while triggering a global toast notification.
acceptanceCriteria: Track report modal opens via 'Report Track' action menu item on all track cards and player bar views, conforming to WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard trap and screen reader accessibility guidelines per constraint 5 and sec-024.
Dropdown requires selecting a valid reason enum (COPYRIGHT_VIOLATION, INAPPROPRIATE_CONTENT, SPAM_OR_MISLEADING, OTHER) and enforces a 500-character limit on the optional details textarea.
Submitting dispatches POST /api/v1/tracks/:trackId/reports and displays a loading spinner on the submit button.

On HTTP 201 Created response, modal transitions to confirmation view displaying 'Thank you. Your report has been submitted for moderation review.', automatically dismisses after 3 seconds, and fires a success toast.
On HTTP 409 or 429 errors, displays an inline alert inside the modal without clearing user inputs.
Styled using dark-mode HSL design tokens and shadcn/ui Dialog/Select components per sec-026.

Unit tests in components/ReportModal.test.tsx cover form validation and state transitions; Playwright spec in e2e/tests/report-modal.spec.ts verifies opening, submitting, auto-dismissing, and error alerts.

userStories.title: Implement Admin Moderation Queue REST API Endpoint
userStories.description: Build the backend API endpoint GET /api/v1/admin/reports to return user-submitted content flags requiring evaluation. The endpoint is protected by admin RBAC middleware and supports query parameters for status, reason, slaBreach, limit, and offset, computing real-time DMCA 48-hour SLA remaining seconds and breach status for each pending item.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/admin/reports requires an authenticated JWT session with admin role; unauthenticated requests return 401 Unauthorized and non-admin requests return 403 Forbidden per constraint 3.
Supports query parameters status (PENDING, RESOLVED_APPROVED, RESOLVED_REJECTED), reason, slaBreach (boolean), limit (default 20, max 100), and offset per sec-004 contract.

Response payload includes report details, reporter info (masked IP for guests), target track metadata (title, coverImageUrl, status, artistId, artistName), and ISO-8601 UTC timestamps per constraint 0.
Computes slaRemainingSeconds (172800 seconds minus elapsed time since createdAt) and sets isSlaBreached = true if slaRemainingSeconds <= 0.
Integration test in tests/api/admin-reports.test.ts asserts 401/403 guards for unauthorized users, 200 OK payload schema, pagination parameters, and SLA calculation accuracy.

userStories.title: Implement Admin Content Takedown and Report Dismissal APIs
userStories.description: Implement POST /api/v1/admin/reports/:reportId/approve and POST /api/v1/admin/reports/:reportId/reject endpoints. Approval executes an atomic transaction setting Report.status to RESOLVED_APPROVED and Track.status to takedown (isLive = false), excluding the track from search/recs and revoking presigned playback URLs, while writing an immutable AuditLog record.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/admin/reports/:reportId/approve and .../reject enforce server-side admin role check via middleware returning 401/403 for non-admins per constraint 3.

Approve endpoint executes an atomic Prisma transaction: sets Report.status = RESOLVED_APPROVED, updates resolvedAt (UTC ISO-8601 per constraint 0), sets Track.status = takedown, and sets isLive = false.
Taken-down tracks are excluded from search queries, recommendation feeds, and return 404 Not Found on presigned URL generation requests and 403 on active stream segments.
Reject endpoint executes an atomic Prisma transaction: sets Report.status = RESOLVED_REJECTED, updates resolvedAt, and leaves Track.status as live.

Both endpoints write an immutable AuditLog entry recording adminId, action (REPORT_APPROVED_UNPUBLISH or REPORT_REJECTED_DISMISS), targetEntityId, adminNotes, and duration in milliseconds per sec-025.
Integration test in tests/api/admin-takedown.test.ts verifies atomic status transitions, AuditLog creation, and presigned stream URL HTTP 404 rejection post-takedown.

userStories.title: Implement Frontend Admin Moderation Queue Dashboard

Clicking track preview opens an isolated admin audio player modal to listen to the reported track without altering user queue state.
Approve Takedown and Reject buttons trigger confirmation modals with mandatory admin notes text fields, invoking the respective approval/rejection endpoints.

userStories.title: Implement Admin User Status Mutation API and Session Revocation
userStories.description: Build PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/:userId/status to update account states to active, suspended, or banned. Enforces mandatory reason payload validation, prevents moderating Admin accounts (403 CANNOT_MODERATE_ADMIN), sets user.tokenInvalidatedBefore to trigger immediate session revocation in authentication middleware, and writes an AuditLog entry.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/:userId/status validates payload: status ('active', 'suspended', 'banned'), mandatory reason string, and optional suspensionDurationDays.
Returns HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity with code REASON_REQUIRED if reason is empty or omitted.
Rejects attempts to suspend or ban users with the Admin role, returning HTTP 403 Forbidden with code CANNOT_MODERATE_ADMIN.

When transitioning status to suspended or banned, updates User.tokenInvalidatedBefore to current UTC time (constraint 0); authentication middleware rejects tokens with iat < tokenInvalidatedBefore with 401 SESSION_REVOKED.
Writes a synchronous AuditLog record containing action (USER_SUSPENDED, USER_BANNED, or USER_REINSTATED), adminId, targetUserId, previousStatus, newStatus, reason, and metadata per sec-025.
Integration test in tests/api/admin-user-status.test.ts verifies status transition, 403 on admin targeting, 422 on missing reason, AuditLog creation, and token invalidation timestamp update.

userStories.title: Implement Content Soft-Hide and Reinstatement Engine for Moderated Accounts
userStories.description: Implement the platform-wide content visibility engine enforcing decision DEC-003. When a user is suspended or banned, an atomic database transaction sets isSoftHidden = true on all tracks and public playlists owned by the user. Upon account reinstatement to active, soft-hidden items are set to isSoftHidden = false (preserving independent DMCA takedowns), immediately restoring search and stream visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Account status change to suspended or banned triggers an atomic transaction setting isSoftHidden = true on all Track records linked to the user's ArtistProfile and all Playlist records owned by the user.
Read queries for global search, genre browse, and recommendation feeds enforce isSoftHidden: false filter, excluding soft-hidden tracks and playlists.
Navigating to an artist profile or playlist page of a suspended/banned user returns HTTP 404 Not Found; direct audio presigned URL requests return HTTP 404/410 Gone.
Account reinstatement to active sets isSoftHidden = false for user tracks and playlists, while preserving status = 'takedown' for tracks independently removed via DMCA moderation under sec-021.
Retains user records, audio files, and playlist definitions indefinitely in database and cloud storage without hard deletion.

Unit tests in services/visibilityEngine.test.ts and integration tests in tests/api/soft-hide.test.ts verify atomic flag updates, query filtering, and preservation of DMCA takedown states during reinstatement.

userStories.title: Implement Daily Platform Statistics Aggregation Cron Job and Metric Snapshot Model

userStories.title: Implement Server Health Check API Endpoint for Load Balancer Probes

userStories.title: Implement GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline Workflow for Automated Lint, Test, and ECS Deployment
